description: Phase 9: Unified Conversation Thread — replace isolated per-agent chat panels with a single shared conversation thread per project.

userStories.title: Make agentType nullable on Message and run Prisma migration
userStories.description: As a developer, I need to make agentType nullable on the Message model so user messages don't require agent attribution.
acceptanceCriteria: In prisma/schema.prisma, change `agentType String @default("trend-mapper")` to `agentType String?` (remove @default, make nullable)
The @@index([projectId, agentType, createdAt]) index is kept (nullable column indexes are valid in SQLite)
Run `npx prisma migrate dev --name make-agentType-nullable` and migration completes without error
Run `npx prisma generate` to regenerate the client
Typecheck passes with `npx tsc --noEmit`
userStories.notes: Read prisma/schema.prisma first. SQLite does not support ALTER COLUMN — Prisma will generate a table-recreate migration. This is safe: existing rows keep their agentType values. Run migrate dev from the project root (/Users/rajas/Desktop/AntiGravity/Fund2Updated).

userStories.title: Update all 4 route handlers to accept full client-sent history
userStories.description: As a developer, I need each agent route handler to accept the full messages array from the client instead of reloading history from DB, so agents receive cross-agent context.
acceptanceCriteria: Glob for all route.ts files under app/api/chat/ and src/app/api/chat/ — identify all 4 agent route handlers
In all 4 route handlers: extract `const { messages: clientHistory, currentSession = 1, deepResearch = false } = await request.json()`
Remove the `prisma.message.findMany` call that loads history by agentType in each handler
Apply rolling window to clientHistory: `const windowed = applyRollingWindow(clientHistory)`
Add mergeConsecutiveSameRole helper in each file: reduce consecutive same-role messages by concatenating content with '\n\n'
Apply mergeConsecutiveSameRole after rolling window before streamText
Build historyMessages for Vertex AI from windowed.slice(0, -1): `map(msg => ({ role: msg.role === 'user' ? 'user' as const : 'assistant' as const, content: msg.content }))`
Extract user message: `const userMessageContent = clientHistory[clientHistory.length - 1].content`
Persist user message: `prisma.message.create({ data: { projectId, agentType: AGENT_TYPE, role: 'user', content: userMessageContent } })`
Persist assistant in onFinish: `prisma.message.create({ data: { projectId, agentType: AGENT_TYPE, role: 'model', content: event.text } })`
All 4 route files contain `clientHistory[clientHistory.length - 1]`
None of the 4 route files contain `prisma.message.findMany` (history loading removed)
Typecheck passes with `npx tsc --noEmit`
userStories.notes: Read each route handler fully before editing. Glob for route.ts under app/api/chat/ AND src/app/api/chat/ — the project may have files in both locations. The trend mapper route is typically at app/api/chat/[projectId]/route.ts. Value designer, SPI, and FARO routes are at their respective subdirectories. The mergeConsecutiveSameRole function handles edge cases where error recovery left consecutive same-role messages in the history, which Vertex AI would reject.

userStories.title: Refactor Server Component and AgentWorkspace for unified message loading
userStories.description: As a developer, I need the project page to load all messages in one query and pass them as a flat array to AgentWorkspace.
acceptanceCriteria: Find the Server Component for the project page (app/projects/[projectId]/page.tsx or src/app/projects/[projectId]/page.tsx)
Read the Server Component fully before editing
Replace multiple agentType-filtered prisma.message.findMany calls with a single: `prisma.message.findMany({ where: { projectId }, orderBy: { createdAt: 'asc' } })`
Normalize role in the result: `messages.map(m => ({ ...m, role: m.role === 'model' ? 'assistant' : m.role }))`
Pass `initialMessages` (flat array) to AgentWorkspace instead of `initialMessagesByAgent` (Record)
Read src/components/AgentWorkspace.tsx fully before editing
In AgentWorkspace: remove the per-agent absolute-positioned panel map and AgentTabs import
In AgentWorkspace: add `const [activeAgent, setActiveAgent] = useState('trend-mapper')`
In AgentWorkspace: update props interface from `initialMessagesByAgent: Record<string, Message[]>` to `initialMessages: UnifiedMessage[]`
AgentWorkspace renders a placeholder div for UnifiedChatWindow (will be replaced in US-005)
AgentWorkspace.tsx no longer imports AgentTabs
AgentWorkspace.tsx contains `useState('trend-mapper')`
The Server Component no longer contains multiple prisma.message.findMany calls with agentType filter
Typecheck passes with `npx tsc --noEmit`
userStories.notes: The Server Component location may be app/projects/[projectId]/page.tsx OR src/app/projects/[projectId]/page.tsx — check both. The UnifiedMessage type can be defined in AgentWorkspace.tsx for now: `interface UnifiedMessage { id: string; role: string; content: string; agentType?: string | null; isError?: boolean }`. It's OK to render a placeholder div for UnifiedChatWindow in this story — US-005 builds the real component.

acceptanceCriteria: Create src/components/AgentPicker.tsx
AgentPicker accepts props: `{ activeAgent: string; onAgentChange: (agent: string) => void }`
Renders 4 pill buttons with ids and labels: trend-mapper/TREND MAPPER, value-designer/VALUE DESIGNER, spi/SPI, faro/FARO
Active pill style: `bg-[#ebff00] text-[#1a2024]`
Inactive pill style: `border border-[#b1dbd8]/20 text-[#b1dbd8]/40 hover:text-[#b1dbd8]`
Pill base style: `px-3 py-1 text-[10px] font-medium tracking-[0.2em] uppercase transition-colors`
Font: `style={{ fontFamily: "'Rajdhani', sans-serif" }}`
Container: `flex gap-2 px-4 pt-2 pb-1`
Clicking a pill calls onAgentChange with that agent's id
src/components/AgentPicker.tsx exists
Typecheck passes with `npx tsc --noEmit`
Verify in browser using dev-browser skill
userStories.notes: Read src/components/AgentTabs.tsx for existing styling patterns. The pills are a simpler variant — no underline/border-b-2 tab styling, just filled vs bordered pills. Import this component into AgentWorkspace after creating it.

userStories.title: Create UnifiedChatWindow — single shared message list for all agents
userStories.description: As a student, I want all agent conversations to appear in one scrollable thread so I can see the full history without switching panels.
acceptanceCriteria: Read src/components/ChatWindow.tsx fully before creating UnifiedChatWindow
Create src/components/UnifiedChatWindow.tsx
Props: `{ projectId: string; initialMessages: UnifiedMessage[]; activeAgent: string; onAgentChange: (agent: string) => void; currentSession: number }`
Single messages state initialized from initialMessages
On submit: optimistically append user message `{ id: crypto.randomUUID(), role: 'user', content: userText }` to messages state
Endpoint map: trend-mapper -> `/api/chat/${projectId}`, value-designer -> `/api/chat/value-designer/${projectId}`, spi -> `/api/chat/spi/${projectId}`, faro -> `/api/chat/faro/${projectId}`
POST body: `JSON.stringify({ messages: messages.map(m => ({ role: m.role, content: m.content, agentType: m.agentType })), currentSession, deepResearch })`
Renders AgentPicker above message list and ChatInput below (column flex layout)

Each assistant message renders agent label: derive from AGENT_DISPLAY_NAMES map `{ 'trend-mapper': 'TREND MAPPER', 'value-designer': 'VALUE DESIGNER', 'spi': 'SPI', 'faro': 'FARO' }` — fallback 'AGENT'
User messages render 'YOU' label (no agentType check needed — role === 'user' is sufficient)
showDeepResearch passed to ChatInput: `activeAgent === 'trend-mapper' || activeAgent === 'faro'`
Empty state shows generic message (not agent-specific) — e.g. 'Select an agent above and start a conversation'
On assistant response: append `{ id: crypto.randomUUID(), role: 'assistant', content: fullText, agentType: activeAgent }` to messages
AgentWorkspace imports and renders UnifiedChatWindow (replace the placeholder from US-003)
src/components/UnifiedChatWindow.tsx exists
Typecheck passes with `npx tsc --noEmit`

Verify in browser using dev-browser skill — send a message with TREND MAPPER selected, switch to FARO, send another; both messages appear in one thread with correct agent labels above each assistant bubble
userStories.notes: Read src/components/ChatWindow.tsx fully — UnifiedChatWindow reuses the same streaming pattern (ReadableStream/getReader), thinking indicator, error handling, and auto-scroll behavior. Key differences from ChatWindow: (1) messages include all agents not one; (2) POST endpoint derived from activeAgent at send time; (3) agent label per message from msg.agentType. Re-use ChatInput and MessageBubble unchanged. Also re-use the same streaming approach (getReader loop). The UnifiedMessage type should be exported from this file or a shared types file so AgentWorkspace can import it.
